gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Shaw opposes allowing boys or transgender girls to use girls’ locker rooms or compete on girls’ sports teams.
gender.quote: Policies allowing boys to undress in girls' locker rooms and play on their sports teams undermine fairness and safety.

tax.text: Barrera supports increasing education funding through sustainable, progressive revenue and treating Proposition 98 as a funding floor rather than a ceiling.
tax.quote: Secure sustainable, progressive revenue so funding is stable across economic cycles and resources reach students with the greatest needs.

wages.text: Barrera helped raise the minimum wage and supports improving educator compensation and working conditions.
wages.quote: Outside education, I helped raise the minimum wage and secure paid sick days for more than 200,000 workers.

housing.text: Barrera proposes using public land, including school-district land, to build permanently affordable housing and supports educator housing strategies.
housing.quote: California should treat public land as a long term public asset and use more of it to build permanently affordable housing at scale

schools.text: Barrera supports fully funded public education and keeping education funds focused on district classrooms and direct student supports.
schools.quote: Preserve the core promise of public education by keeping funds focused on classrooms and direct student supports.

immigration.text: Barrera supports enforcing protections for immigrant students and ensuring students are not denied equal access based on immigration status.
immigration.quote: The state has a duty to make sure students are not denied equal access because of disability, race, language status, immigration status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

gender.text: Barrera supports protecting LGBTQ students and enforcing protections against discrimination based on gender identity.
gender.quote: That means protecting the rights of LGBTQ+ students and ensuring schools are places of belonging, not exclusion.
